reviewType: Codex AI linguistic and visual localization review of actual rendered screenshots
limitations: Not independent human or specialist approval.
Contact sheets cover eight panels per locale; full-size report-preview panel inspected separately for each locale. Other panels were assessed through the contact sheets.
Only the first visible PDF page was reviewed; the complete exported document was not inspected.
Known global API36 navigation-brand/status-bar crop defect is being fixed separately; current assets require recapture.
This review does not establish speech-engine support, safety compliance, final store acceptance or all-screen accessibility.

findings.observed: Report preview remains at Menyiapkan pratinjau laporan... with no PDF page or pagination visible.
findings.recommendation: Wait for actual PDF rendering and pagination before capturing; fail the capture instead of exporting the loading state. Reinspect regenerated Indonesian report panel.

observed.pl-PL: Radio reads 1 sztuki; batteries read 12 sztuki; water reads 6 butelki.
observed.sv-SE: Radio reads 1 stycken (also visible in panel 02).

findings.cause: Synthetic fixture unitItems/unitBottles strings are reused with multiple numerical quantities; they are not count-aware.

recommendation.pt-BR: Use quantity-neutral abbreviation un. for unitItems.
recommendation.pt-PT: Use quantity-neutral abbreviation un. for unitItems.
recommendation.pl-PL: Use szt. for unitItems; for the fixed six-bottle and eight-tin fixtures use butelek and puszek respectively, or generate unit inflections by count.
recommendation.sv-SE: Use quantity-neutral abbreviation st for unitItems.

findings.observed: In-app navigation brand is clipped under the status bar/crop in the native screenshot embedded in panels 01–07.
findings.recommendation: Use root-owned safe-inset fix and recapture; do not approve the current assets.

observations: All six locales show genuinely localized navigation, core headings, synthetic record values and typed expiry commands; brand/technical PDF terminology is retained intentionally.
No missing glyphs or broken diacritics observed in the reviewed Portuguese, Polish, Swedish, Turkish or Indonesian text.
Long marketing headlines fit within their panels in the current contact sheets.
The five fully rendered report-preview panels show localized report labels and records with no observed text overlap or cutoff; body type is small because the page is shown at fit-page scale.
Cards continuing below the scroll viewport are normal scrolling content and were not reported as clipping.
